structured.answer: The site does explain it: on the guide page there's a card "מדד S&P 500", 500 big American companies, money invested "בדולרים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו". The "שני חלקים בכל חיסכון" bit made me get that the S&P is what the money is in, and it still needs a place to sit, like a קרן השתלמות or a "חשבון ניירות ערך".

stuck.why: Big form 'מה השאלה שלכם?' with ₪ fields is on the right where I look first; the box that actually explains products ('להבין סוג של חיסכון') is on the left

stuck.where: מדריך page, middle (פרישה / לילדים / לבחירה עצמית)
stuck.why: Lots of same-looking cards, no sign of which is for me; almost stopped scrolling before reaching the S&P card
Index cards (MSCI, ת"א-125, נאסד"ק) all look alike; only found S&P because I was looking for that exact name

used: Home card 'להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה'
'שני חלקים בכל חיסכון' block on מדריך
Card 'קרן השתלמות' (tax-free withdrawal after a period)
skimmed: Home cards 'מה חברה מציעה לי', 'כסף שיושב בעו"ש', 'מה כבר יש לכם'
skipped: The 'מה השאלה שלכם?' form and ₪ fields
unsure_meaning: קרן שעוקבת אחריו – is that the same as תעודת סל?
not_found: What investing in S&P costs, in shekels
A clear 'first step' for someone with cash in the bank
Which card to start with if you're a plain employee with savings

findings.what: About 25 same-looking cards with no suggested starting point for a beginner; tiring on a phone
S&P 500, the thing most beginners have heard of, is near the very bottom
The explain-a-product entry is on the left side, while the big form dominates the right
Short card texts use jargon (מק"מ, אג"ח, צמודה) without explaining it
No cost shown on the cards, so you can't tell what anything costs
